_comment: The settlement around the village square. Structures from the Quaternius Farm Buildings pack (docs/ASSET_LEDGER.md), placed by scripts/world/village.gd: each entry is stood on the ground by asking the world (D09), given a box collider, and scaled by its own `scale` — the pack is authored at roughly 2x real size, so most corrections sit near 0.75. Positions are world metres on and around the square flat at [10,-10] (terrain_playground.json `flats`). ALL TUNABLE.
_comment_layout: Grandpa's house (built by grandpa_house.gd, not listed here) sits west at [-22,-16] facing the square. The barns frame the square's north and east, the well marks its middle, the windmill stands off the north-east corner where it reads from the whole meadow, and the fences run along the practice-meadow path so day one is bracketed by the settlement on one side and open grass on the other.
